coordinate_system.time_scale: UTC labels; Horizons states requested in ICRF with Horizons' internal TDB integration

provenance.method: Mission-event reconstruction with moving-Moon JPL ephemeris. NASA's initial 60.0 by 168.5 nmi lunar ellipse and 73:35:07 MET circularization replace two formerly circular representative revolutions; the remaining eight are approximately 60 nmi circular. Orbit plane orientation and full sample positions are modeled, not tracking telemetry.
